mem.10:
- 21 May 2023: John said he had signed with the Minnesota Wolves as a shooting guard. The opener was scheduled for 22–28 May. He wanted to improve his shooting percentage; preseason challenge was fitting the team’s style. He said things were going well, teammates were nice, and he was having fun. Loves discussing his sneaker collection.
- 14–20 May 2023: Tim was developing a Harry Potter fan project with a fan friend, covering characters, spells, and magical creatures. He enjoyed fans collaborating. A few years earlier, he’d taken an amazing tour at a London place that felt like a Harry Potter movie. John hadn’t visited HP-related places but wanted to.
- 14 June 2023: Tim joined a fantasy literature forum and had an enriching conversation about favorite books.
- 15 June: John was considering endorsements, including Nike and Under Armour, but had not chosen; he’d update Tim. He shared a gym basketball photo and said he gives his all on court. Tim shared a bookshelf photo with a MinaLima picture; he loves their work and said they made all HP film props. HP reminders help Tim escape, and he might visit more related places.
- 9–15 July: John scored a then-career-high 40 points in a tough win. The team celebrated at a restaurant, laughing and reliving the game. He sees passionate teammates as close, like a second family, who push each other. Tim had a pleasant conversation with a Harry Potter fan in California. Fantasy reading gives Tim escape and freedom; reading somewhere comfortable makes him blissful and immersed.
- By 16 July: John used basketball contacts and marketing skills to network for endorsements. He had signed with Nike for shoes/gear and was talking with Gatorade about sponsorship. He likes Under Armour and would like to work with them. He looked forward to an August game in Seattle, a favorite city for its energy, diversity, food/seafood, and supportive fans. He loves the ocean and called summer surfing with friends unreal; he started surfing around 2018 and likes its connection to nature.
- July 2023: Tim called an event one of his favorite experiences of belonging, because everyone shared and understood his interest. He hoped to attend a September book conference with authors, publishers, and readers to discuss novels/new releases, learn about literature, and deepen his connection to it.
- 2 August: Tim said he was writing fantasy-novel articles for an online magazine after finding it on the forum and pitching ideas the magazine liked. Articles cover characters, themes, and recommendations; he especially enjoys Harry Potter and Game of Thrones. John and Anthony attended a charity event and HP trivia contest; they did all right, while a knowledgeable contestant won a book. John shared a photo of a book with someone holding a bookmark. He was reading an inspiring book reminding him to dream and pursue goals.
- 1–7 August: John’s team won a close game; John scored the final basket to a cheering crowd. His only photo showed play in a large arena. He described his close-knit team as family away from home: they encourage each other and spend time together outside sport.
- 9 August: Tim had recently Skyped with the California HP fan; they discussed characters and possible collaboration. He was reading an unnamed Patrick Rothfuss fantasy book and praised its world-building and characters; he recommended it to John, who promised to read it. Tim later specifically recommended *The Name of the Wind*, praising its magician-musician protagonist, world-building, and character development.
- 11 August: John had recently visited Chicago and liked its energy and friendly locals. He enjoys shared excitement at stadium games, with fans cheering and chanting. Tim had attended an unspecified event with people sharing his interests and was writing more articles because writing combines reading and sharing stories.
- John’s lucky basketball shoes have been with him through successes, failures, and friendships; they symbolize resilience, determination, love of basketball, and his progress. Basketball has been part of his life since childhood: watched NBA with his father and dreamed of major courts; his father enrolled him in a local league at age 10. He played through middle/high school, earned a college scholarship, and was drafted after college. Top career goal: win a championship; also wants charity work and to inspire people. He was teaming with a local organization supporting disadvantaged children in sports and school.
- 15 August: After a trip, John reunited with teammates, who warmly welcomed him and gave him an autographed basketball as a friendship/appreciation gift. It reminds him of their bond, support, beginnings, and journey, and motivates him to stay strong and give his all.
- 21 August: John found a new gym with a basketball court for fitness/pro training. Workout adjustment was initially challenging, but he found balance through trial and error, listening to his body, and resting. Schedule combines basketball and strength training. He shared a workout-plan photo. Strength training builds muscle/power, prevents injury, boosts explosiveness/athleticism, and improved his shooting accuracy, agility, speed, advantage over opponents, and confidence.
- 21 August: Tim was focusing on school, fantasy reading, and piano. Piano was challenging but satisfying; he liked playing different songs, especially a favorite movie theme that brought good memories. *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* is special as the first film and one he watched with family: snacks, blanket, then becoming absorbed. John owned the complete HP movie collection.
- 21 August: John shared a photo of people around a kitchen table; his family gathers often. Tim values family meals, love, and laughter. His family prepares Thanksgiving dinner, shares what they’re thankful for, then watches several movies, including *Home Alone*. At holidays they watch *Elf* (fun/festive) and *The Santa Clause* (heartwarming/festive). John shared a photo of the previous year’s Christmas tree; Tim shared his decorated Harry Potter-themed tree.
- 26 August: Tim had an overwhelming week of assignments/exams but persevered and balanced study with fantasy reading. He loves fantasy and magical worlds, has never been on a sports team, enjoys travel as another kind of magic, and wanted to visit NYC.
- 19–25 August (reported 26 August): John visited home, caught up with family/old friends, and reminisced about childhood. He played with a girls’ basketball group for four years in high school. He enjoys exploring cities; shared an NYC trip photo, said it was amazing, and liked exploring and restaurants; recommended NYC for culture/food and offered to help Tim when he visits. John shared photos of the girls’ team posing and an NYC skyline/skyscraper. Tim shared photos of books and a bookshelf with a clock.
- 31 August 2023: Tim said he’d been rejected for a summer job but was staying positive. John encouraged him and said his NYC trip went okay: he initially struggled with the subway, then someone explained it and it became easy. Tim said he’d given a class presentation the previous day; nervous but pleased to have done it as progress. John praised him and said he’d been trying recipes, sharing a photo of soup with a spoon and butternut on a cutting board. He improvised it, had no recipe, and said he used sage. Tim likes experimenting with spices and planned to look up a recipe. Tim was planning his first Universal Studios trip the next month, especially excited for the Harry Potter attractions; John hadn’t been but had it on his bucket list. John wished him a great, safe trip; Tim promised to report back. They said goodbye and planned to catch up.
mem.20:
John: Professional basketball shooting guard for Minnesota Wolves; signed 21 May 2023. Started playing young (local league at 10, then school, college scholarship, drafted); watched NBA with father. Loves Wolves, admires LeBron James’s skill, leadership and work ethic; met him several times and found him chill. Collects jerseys/sneakers, discusses sneakers. Goals: improve shooting/consistency/impact, win championship, help team, inspire others, do charity work, leave a legacy, perhaps start a foundation. Mentors young players. Volunteered with organization supporting disadvantaged children through sports and school.

Basketball/team: Team close-knit and supportive, like family. Career-high 40 points in tough win (9–15 Jul 2023), celebrated at restaurant; made final basket in close win (1–7 Aug), crowd cheered. Enjoys crowds’ shared excitement; memorable 2022 comeback from big fourth-quarter deficit. Lucky shoes symbolize resilience and love of basketball. Had ankle injury requiring time off/physical therapy; learned patience and perseverance. Doctor said injury wasn’t too serious 16 Nov 2023; recovering slowly by 21 Nov. Reflects on mistakes, owns them, works to improve. Training includes basketball and strength work for power, injury prevention, explosiveness, agility, speed, confidence and shooting; found a new gym 21 Aug. 1 Dec tried yoga for strength/flexibility; said it improved focus and balance. Likes Warrior II and a balance/stability pose; holds pose 30–60 seconds and shared photo demonstrating it. Teammates celebrated trophy win after a tough season (13 Oct; accompanying photo appeared to show soccer team). Autographed basketball from teammates after trip (15 Aug) represented friendship/support/journey. New teammates joined restaurant outing 11–17 Sep; planned October city trip, destination undecided; Tim suggested Edinburgh, which John hadn’t visited.

Travel/life: Loves Seattle (energy, diversity, seafood, fans); expected game there Aug 2023. Visited Chicago (11 Aug) and NYC (subway confusing at first, locals helped; offered Tim help 26 Aug). Loves ocean; began surfing around 2018 and had an “unreal” summer surfing with friends. Married girlfriend in intimate greenhouse ceremony the week before 2 Oct 2023; loved ones and hiking-club friends attended. Bride’s walk down aisle moved him; first dance at cozy candlelit restaurant. European holiday with wife began 6 Nov; road trip along coast by 11 Nov. Likes nature and time away from city. On 1 Dec shared photos of forest near hometown (tranquil), lake, camping at mountains with campfire; enjoyed relaxing and fresh air. Rocky Mountains trip was previous year; described snow-capped peaks as stunning and restorative. Earlier shared unidentified mountain-group photo. 21 Oct bucket list included castles, cultures and architecture.

Other John: Family always supportive, team second family; likes movies, dinner with loved ones, reading and cooking. Favorite meal honey-garlic chicken with roasted vegetables; offered recipe; improvised butternut soup with sage. Loved The Alchemist, reread 21 Nov and felt hopeful/motivated to trust process and follow dreams. Also likes nonfiction/personal development and mindset books; owns complete Harry Potter movie collection. Uses motivational quotes/strategies on whiteboard and desk plaque. 21 Aug shared family kitchen-table photo. Considered Nike/Under Armour 15 Jun; signed Nike shoes/gear deal by 16 Jul and discussed Gatorade; values authentic endorsements, likes Under Armour. Needed shoes 13 Oct; Tim suggested black/pink running shoes online.

Tim: Fantasy/book fan and collector; reading is escape, enjoys imagining worlds. Especially likes Harry Potter and Game of Thrones; fan project on characters, spells and magical creatures. Joined fantasy literature forum 14 Jun, leading to online magazine opportunity (2 Aug), writing about fantasy themes/characters and recommendations. Writing fantasy novel; UK castles inspired ideas (21 Oct); writing is nerve-wracking but joyful; J.K. Rowling inspires detailed storytelling. Struggled with plot twist 30 Oct–5 Nov; persisted. UK HP conference 6–12 Oct was welcoming/inspiring. Visited HP-like London site/tour years before May 2023; wants to return; likes MinaLima props. Attended unspecified fan event in July, hoped to attend September book conference; planned first Universal Studios visit in September, excited for HP attractions. Skyped California HP fan about collaboration 9 Aug; had pleasant fan conversation 9–15 Jul. Shared quote: “Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times.” Likes castles; visited one in UK 10 Nov, shared castle/river photo. Recommended Patrick Rothfuss, particularly The Name of the Wind (protagonist, world-building, character development); John agreed to read. Shared photo featuring “storm of swords” (title uncertain); 11 Nov favorite show named only “That.” Shared photo of woman statue in blue hat.

Tim also enjoys travel, road trips, hiking and board games; wanted to visit NYC (26 Aug). Never played on sports team. Busy with school; learned piano 21 Aug, liked movie theme and memories. Exams/assignments overwhelming 26 Aug; turned down for summer job 31 Aug; nervous presentation 30 Aug but completed. Exams 13–19 Nov; studies in 25-minute blocks with 5-minute breaks. Thanksgiving feast with family; gratitude, Home Alone, Elf, The Santa Clause; watched Philosopher’s Stone with family/snacks/blanket and shared HP Christmas tree. Grateful for family/friends. 21 Nov shared books on wooden floor, called them companions on growth journey. Likes psychology/self-improvement books; unnamed book on small changes changed how he does things; The Alchemist changed his perspective on goals.

1 Dec 2023: Tim said a tough exam the previous week caused self-doubt, but studying hard turned it into a learning experience and showed resilience; shared notepad/pen photo. John congratulated and encouraged him. Tim valued John’s support and friendship; John said friendship mutual. Tim reorganized bookshelf and shared photos; John liked The Hobbit and said he’d read another popular fantasy series (series unnamed). Both enjoy books as escape/adventure in other worlds. John shared forest photo; discussed nature as tranquil, grounding and restorative. Tim recalled summer trip/camping; John said they camped in mountains, enjoyed nature. Tim shared photo of plane over snowy mountain; John shared Rocky Mountains trip photo; both said nature humbles, calms and connects us to something bigger.

Shared: Tim’s prized possession is LeBron-signed basketball; cites LeBron’s 2016 Finals Game 7 chase-down block on Andre Iguodala as determination; John agreed it showed heart. Tim shared Smoky Mountains sunset photo from 2022 (once described as summer 2023). 2 Aug John and Anthony attended charity event and HP trivia; did all right, expert won book. Both praised The Alchemist and enjoy reading.

Mentors younger players, adjusts to their needs and enjoys their trust/confidence/growth. Strength work improves power, injury prevention, explosiveness, athleticism, shooting, agility, speed and confidence. Uses motivational quotes/strategies on whiteboard and desk plaque, visualization and teammate support. Yoga by Dec 2023; favorite Warrior II and another unnamed balance pose; holds poses 30–60 sec. Ankle injury previous season required PT, taught patience/perseverance; injury by Nov 2023 not serious, hated missing play. Daily rehab Dec 2023; jogged pain-free 2023-12-15, celebrated with wife, friends and family.

First dance at candlelit restaurant. Close family; childhood friends and four-year high-school girls’ team. Reunited with teammates 2023-08-15 after trip; they gave signed basketball. Enjoys dinner/movies, cooking (honey garlic chicken/roasted vegetables), reading, nature/camping. Nature escapes city noise; Rocky Mountains trip 2022, forest near hometown, mountain camping; found peaceful river/rocks hiking spot. Loves ocean/surfing since ~2018; surfed with friends summer 2023. Seattle favorite (energy, diversity, seafood, fans; game planned Aug 2023); Chicago visit Aug 2023; NYC restaurants/culture, subway initially confusing; stranger helped; offered Tim NYC help. Paris before Jan 2024, loved view; Italy Dec 2023 (food/history/architecture), bought cooking-inspiration book. Short Europe trip with wife Nov 2023; coastal road trip. Castles on bucket list; Edinburgh suggested for team trip, not visited. Reading: The Alchemist (reread Nov 2023; dreams/personal legends), Dune (Dec 2023), LOTR; favorite Aragorn, admires courage/leadership/justice; painting in room. Started Spanish Jan 2024; knows some German and Spanish; shares language app with Tim.

Tim: Fantasy reader/writer. Favorites Harry Potter and Game of Thrones; likes fantasy as escape/imaginative worlds. Also LOTR, Hobbit, Star Wars (favorite), Wheel of Time (series expected Jan 2024), growth/psychology books. Harry Potter complete-film fan; Philosopher’s Stone special childhood family viewing. Admires MinaLima art/props; keeps HP reminders, themed Christmas tree, Gryffindor scarf; received chocolate frog at HP party Dec 2023. Visited London HP-like place/tour years before May 2023; planned first Universal Studios visit Sep 2023, especially HP attractions. Attended UK HP conference 2023-10-06–12; felt part of magical family. HP fan project on characters/spells/creatures; discussed collaborations; spoke with California fan Jul 2023 and Skyped him Aug; met fans at unspecified event Jul. Writes fantasy novel inspired by UK castles and J.K. Rowling’s storytelling. Shared quote: “Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times.” Plot-twist block late Oct/early Nov 2023; story based on UK experiences hit setback Nov. Read book on UK castles; hopes to visit castles.

Smoky Mountains trip 2022; shared sunset photo in 2023. Likes road trips, hiking, board games, reading. Piano learning Aug 2023 (movie theme); violin Dec 2023 (~4 months), classical, hopes to learn jazz/film scores; instrument context had piano/violin ambiguity. Friends/family supportive. Thanksgiving: feast, gratitude, Home Alone, Elf, The Santa Clause. Likes reading in cozy spot; balances study/books. Prized possession: LeBron-signed basketball; cites LeBron’s 2016 Finals chase-down block on Iguodala. Admires Emma Watson’s gender-equality advocacy.

Friendship/latest: Mutual encouragement, books/fantasy; friendship meaningful. Tim shares language-learning app with John. Tim received study-abroad acceptance 2024-01-05; leaves for Ireland Feb 2024 for semester, staying Galway; likes arts, Irish music, vibrant atmosphere. Wants nature exploration and Cliffs of Moher; shared street photo of woman and sunset ocean-cliff photo, plus person atop cliff overlooking ocean. John may stop there after season and promised to let Tim know if nearby; Tim invited him to get in touch. On 2024-01-12, Tim was researching visa requirements for places he wants to visit, finding it overwhelming but exciting and feeling proud of taking initiative. He’ll keep John updated on travels. John recommended Barcelona: culture, architecture, neighborhood food and nearby beaches; Tim added it to his list.

Photos shared across sessions: Tim’s bookshelves, Middle-earth map and Westendell map; John’s gym, team, travel, books, yoga and nature. Some people/locations and unnamed works remain unidentified (e.g. unnamed fantasy show “That”).
